name: Aromatase (CYP19A1) zearalenone-inhibition molecular model
description: A structure-based in silico model of human aromatase (CYP19A1) used to predict whether reported sequence variants of the enzyme change its susceptibility to inhibition by the mycoestrogen zearalenone and its phase I metabolite alpha-zearalenol. A three-dimensional model of the enzyme is built and the ligands are docked into the active site across 434 reported single nucleotide variants, scoring each variant's predicted inhibitory potential. The output is a prediction prioritising variants for later experimental work, not a measured enzyme activity.
spatial_context: The three-dimensional structure of a single protein and its ligand-binding site; no cellular, tissue, or organ context is represented.

references.title: A mechanistic toxicology study to grasp the mechanics of zearalenone estrogenicity: Spotlighting aromatase and the effects of its genetic variability.

computational_method: Homology/3D molecular modelling with ligand docking
prediction_scope: Predicted inhibitory potential of zearalenone and alpha-zearalenol against wild-type and variant aromatase. An in silico prediction with no wet-lab confirmation.
